data.current_description: Adds an ASIN, an Amazon link or a short link (amzn.to, a.co…) to your watchlist. The first check runs in the background within seconds (checking is true until then): poll GET /products/{id}, or send wait: true to get the answer once it's done (up to 45 seconds). Each price check of a tracked product costs 1 credit; a product checked daily uses about 30 credits a month. Without credits the product is added and its first check waits. What Amazon answers shows on the product (last_error), never as an error here. Adding a product you already track returns it unchanged, with status 200.
data.description_suggestion: Adds a product to your watchlist using an ASIN, Amazon product link, or short link (amzn.to, a.co, etc.). Returns the product object with status 201 if newly added or 200 if already tracked. The first price check runs asynchronously in the background (checking: true until complete). Use wait: true to block up to 45 seconds for the initial check, or poll GET /products/{id} to monitor progress. Each price check costs 1 credit; daily-checked products use approximately 30 credits/month. If insufficient credits, the product is added but the first check is deferred. Amazon errors appear in the product's last_error field, not as API errors. Idempotent: adding an already-tracked product returns it unchanged.
